incident_timestamp_display: 5 de julho de 2024 — Voo LA8159 — Aeroporto SCL (ver Fatos Fixos do Incidente)
allegation_summary: It is alleged that a LATAM [[SPK-stewardess-accuser]] on flight LA8159 falsely accused the passenger of aggression against airline personnel, triggering a chain of events including forcible removal by PDI, denial of boarding, and the subsequent imposition of a lifetime ban. The accusation of aggression was subsequently disproven by PDI CCTV review (STG-7), where a DGAC official confirmed the passenger was right and the allegations would be investigated. Despite this, the false accusation was repeated in the fabricated 'carta de desembarque' delivered 9+ hours later and in LATAM's customer service communications. The false accusation constitutes calumnia under CP Art. 412, with criminal-reporting dimension under CP Art. 211 (denuncia calumniosa ante autoridad), and independently triggers civil liability under CC Art. 2314 (responsabilidad extracontractual). CACH Art. 133 serves as supporting/analogical framework: a removal predicated on false accusation cannot constitute lawful denied boarding.

articles.article_name: Codigo Penal de Chile, Art. 412 — Calumnia
articles.article_text: Art. 412. Es calumnia la imputacion de un delito determinado pero falso y que pueda actualmente perseguirse de oficio.

articles.article_name: Codigo Penal de Chile, Art. 211 — Denuncia Calumniosa
articles.article_text: Art. 211. El que imputare falsamente a alguna persona haber cometido un crimen o simple delito, siendo sabedor de la falsedad de la imputacion, o el que la hiciere de malicia, incurrira en las penas de reclusion menor en sus grados minimo a medio y multa de once a quince unidades tributarias mensuales. Si la falsa imputacion se hiciere ante la autoridad judicial o ministerio publico, la pena se aumentara en un grado.

articles.article_name: Codigo Civil de Chile, Art. 2314 — Responsabilidad Extracontractual
articles.article_text: Art. 2314. El que ha cometido un delito o cuasidelito que ha inferido dano a otro, es obligado a la indemnizacion; sin perjuicio de la pena que le impongan las leyes por el delito o cuasidelito.

articles.article_name: Codigo Aeronautico de Chile, Art. 133 — Denegacion de Embarque
articles.article_text: Articulo 133.- Denegacion de Embarque. En el evento que el transportador prevea que tendra que denegar el embarque de uno o mas pasajeros **por sobreventa**...
articles.applicability_rationale: The removal of the passenger from flight LA8159 was predicated on a false accusation of aggression that was subsequently disproven by PDI CCTV review. A removal based on a false accusation is not a lawful denied boarding under CACH Art. 133. The carrier failed to provide any of the statutory options or compensation required under Art. 133, and instead used the false accusation as the basis for a lifetime ban. The false accusation continued to be asserted in official LATAM documentation (the fabricated 'carta de desembarque') even after PDI confirmed the allegations were unfounded. | legacy paraphrase: El transportador podra denegar el embarque a uno o mas pasajeros contra su voluntad, para lo cual debera: 1.- A eleccion del pasajero: a) Embarcar en el siguiente vuelo... b) El reembolso del monto total pagado por el billete... 2.- Sin perjuicio de lo anterior, el transportador debera ofrecer una compensacion al pasajero afectado con la denegacion de embarque...
